text.tspan: Keep your badge with you at all times; you will need
to wear your badge and event-issued lanyard
If you offer to have your badge scanned by sponsor(s)
or at sponsor-branded activities or sessions, you are
instructing AWS to share your Contact Information
and Company Information that you provided at
registration with the sponsor(s) so they may contact
you by email, phone, and post for marketing purposes.
This is optional - you may choose not to offer your
badge. For questions, please refer to the AWS Privacy
Notice. Contact the sponsor(s) to unsubscribe from
with your information may involve transferring it to
another country. For questions about how sponsor(s)
will handle your information, please contact them
directly or refer to their privacy policies.
